step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard depicts two main pipelines: an image processing path and a model training path. First, clients upload images through API Gateway, routing via an Application Load Balancer to an ECS cluster. ECS determines the image category and directs it to an SQS queue. Processing instances (EC2) pull from SQS to run pre-processing, inference, and post-processing tasks. Second, the training pipeline uses SageMaker to load data from S3, train models, and save weights back to S3. On completion, SageMaker triggers a Lambda function to sync the new model weights to the Processing instances.
